items.title: Submit 2025 heating/utility cost statement (Nebenkostenabrechnung)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie die Nebenkostenabrechnung Ihres Vermieters für 2025 bis 08.01.2027 ein.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar deadline of 08.01.2027 for submitting the landlord's utility cost statement for 2025. No period calculation is needed; the date is used as written. 08.01.2027 is a Friday, so no weekend adjustment is required.

items.title: File Widerspruch against the Bürgergeld decision
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei Jobcenter Beispiel-Oderland, Seelower Weg 12, 15344 Musterstrausberg einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated/posted Thursday 19.11.2026. As a Jobcenter (SGB II/X social-law body), delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, posting on/after 1 Jan 2025): counting Fri 20 (1), Sat 21 (2), Sun 22 (3), Mon 23 (4) Nov 2026 -> deemed delivery Monday 23.11.2026 (this is not a tax office, so no weekend-shift of the delivery day applies, and 23.11.2026 is itself a Monday). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG, counted per §§ 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB via § 26 SGB X) starts the day after delivery and ends one month later on the day with the same date number: 23.12.2026. That day is a Wednesday, not a public holiday in Brandenburg, so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.
